title: Authorization
body:
Authorization answers **are you allowed to do this?** — it happens after identity is already established, and decides whether that particular identity may perform a particular action on a particular resource. Roles, permissions, ownership checks, and membership tiers all live here.

The clean split against [[Authentication]] shows up directly in status codes: **401** means the server could not verify who you are at all, while **403 Forbidden** means it verified exactly who you are and that identity still isn't permitted. Authorization checks belong on the [[Backend]] without exception — hiding a button on the frontend is a UX affordance, not a security control, since anyone can call the [[Endpoint]] directly.
